paper_title: MARBLE A Hard Benchmark for Multimodal Spatial Reasoning and Planning
caption: Performance of GPT-o4-mini on with binary or detailed feedback from solution validator. On , the performance will remain 0%.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the accuracy of conversations over multiple rounds, comparing the performance with binary and detailed feedback types. The x-axis is labeled "Round of Conversation" and is a linear scale ranging from 1 to 5, with a tick label interval of 1. The y-axis is labeled "Accuracy (%)" and is a linear scale ranging from 10 to 25, with a tick label interval of 5. A line is present in orange with a circle marker and solid line style, starting at an accuracy of 12.5% at round 1 and increasing to approximately 23.8% at round 5. Another line is present in blue with a square marker and solid line style, starting at an accuracy of 11.3% at round 1 and increasing to approximately 23.3% at round 5.
